topic: Measurement of various electrical and electronic parameters using an Oscilloscope.
syllabus_extract: Measurement of various electrical and electronic parameters using an Oscilloscope.
specific_objectives: 24.8.1.1 Trainee will be able to measure various parameters using an Oscilloscope.

Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Hands-on measurement of voltage, frequency, and duty cycle using a digital oscilloscope; Safety: High voltage caution, proper grounding, and probe compensation verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an oscilloscope?
How does a digital oscilloscope differ from an analog one?
What safety precautions are required when connecting probes to live circuits?

Describe how to adjust the trigger level to stabilize a noisy waveform.
Why is probe compensation necessary before taking accurate measurements?
